analysis.purpose: The trusted-base gate policy: a committed file naming the fixed-argument runners a candidate must pass before it can become trusted memory — the only thing that grants trust.
responsibilities: Declare the runner profiles a candidate is evaluated against
Keep the policy committed and reviewable as ordinary text
Refuse to treat anything not named in the policy as a trust source

businessRules.rule: The policy is a committed artifact, so what grants trust is reviewable in a pull request.
businessRules.rationale: A trust rule that can be changed invisibly is not a trust rule.

businessRules.rule: Runners take fixed arguments named in the policy.
businessRules.rationale: Free-form commands would let a candidate choose the test that blesses it.

nodes.name: Trust policy
nodes.summary: The committed gate that grants memory trust.

edges.rationale: This file defines the trusted-base policy.
